GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings/Mongo:ConnectionString/Jwt:SigningKey values (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path via appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_ProductDatabase: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).
ConnectionStrings._comment_Redis: design-decisions.md 'Caching Strategy for Product Reads' - host:port only, no credentials by default (mirrors kart-category-service's/kart-inventory-service's own ConnectionStrings:Redis convention). Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).

Jwt._comment_SigningKey: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).
